dedupe_keys.name: yield constraint score ycs for five crop stresses on maize rice soybean and wheat

description: This global dataset scores, on a 1 to 5 scale, how strongly five stresses (ozone, pests and diseases, soil nutrients, heat stress and aridity) constrain production of maize, rice, soybean and wheat. Scores are given on a 1 by 1 degree grid, weighted by the distribution of production of each crop from the FAO Global Agro-Ecological Zones data for 2000. Inputs are ozone from the EMEP MSC-W chemical transport model (2010 to 2012), CABI estimates of pre-harvest losses to pests and diseases (2002 to 2004), GAEZ soil nutrient classes derived from the Harmonized World Soil Database (2009), a heat stress index from daily temperatures from 1990 onwards and an aridity index. It was published in July 2020 by Sharps, Mills and ten co-authors under the NERC SUNRISE project, as a shapefile under the Open Government Licence v3.0, free from the Environmental Information Data Centre; it supports a 2018 Global Change Biology paper. Caveats: the grid is coarse, the inputs span different years, and the score is relative, not a yield loss. For simulation it gives a global layer of crop production stress, useful to weight agricultural exposure in food supply and climate risk models. Related catalogue records include the GGCMI crop model outputs and the WRI agricultural exposure to water stress data.
name: Yield Constraint Score (YCS) for five crop stresses on maize, rice, soybean and wheat
provider: Sharps, Mills and co-authors (UKCEH and partners), NERC Environmental Information Data Centre
